source_summary: Winter-toned Chinese river landscape with pale snow mountains, distant low hills, a right-bank grove, quiet water and sandbars, foreground pines and reeds, plus a covered fishing boat with a seated fisherman. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: snow_mountain_mass
motifs.description: Isolate the large pale snow-covered mountain mass in the upper right, including the rounded main summit, layered foothill slopes, ink-wash shadows, exposed rock strokes, and small dark conifer dots along ridges.
must_preserve: dark clustered tree dots on ridgelines

motifs.name: left_distant_hill_chain
motifs.description: Isolate the low undulating distant hills stretching from the left edge toward center, behind the foreground trees and before the main mountain mass.

motifs.name: right_bank_winter_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the grove of bare winter trees on the right middle bank, with the low shoreline mound beneath it and sparse brush texture around the trunks.
must_preserve: light ink wash on the bank

motifs.name: midstream_sandbars
motifs.description: Isolate the pale horizontal sandbars and shallow-water edges in the middle-right river, including the thin ink outlines and soft washed islands.
must_preserve: soft broken edges suggesting shallow water
subtle tonal separation from surrounding river

motifs.name: foreground_pine_bare_tree_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground tree cluster at left: twisting pine trunk and branches with blue-green needle clusters, adjacent bare white-branched trees, and dark vertical foliage accents along the base. Exclude the boat and figure visible behind it.
must_preserve: dark dotted foliage along lower trunks

motifs.name: foreground_reeds_shrubs
motifs.description: Isolate the low reeds, grasses, and leafy shrubs at the lower left foreground near the water’s edge, separate from the main tree trunks and boat.

motifs.name: covered_fishing_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the small wooden fishing boat in the lower center-left, including the curved hull, pointed prow, low woven canopy, and blue cloth or cover at the stern. Exclude the seated fisherman as a separate motif.
must_preserve: blue color accent at the stern

motifs.name: seated_fisherman_with_rod
motifs.description: Isolate the seated fisherman on the boat, including straw rain cape, round hat, face and beard, folded white trousers, hands, and the short visible fishing rod or line segment projecting to the right. Exclude calligraphy and seals.
must_preserve: small facial features and dark beard

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
